story_type: kayaker in cold water with waders filling, swimmer and basket hoist
hook: His waders filled with seawater off the Oregon coast.
narration: He went into the water in rubber waders, and they started filling up.
He had fallen in near Haystack Rock, off the Oregon coast.
A Jayhawk crew came straight from training and lowered a swimmer.
A life jacket holds you up, but waders full of cold water pull the other way.
[short pause] The swimmer got him clear, and the basket came down for each man.
outcome: Within fifteen minutes, the rescue swimmer had recovered both men.
title: Kayaker's waders filled with seawater
description:
On May 16, 2020, a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew rescued two kayakers in distress near Haystack Rock off Pacific City, Oregon, after one fell into the water wearing rubber waders.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Trevor Lilburn, U.S. Coast Guard Northwest, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/753023/coast-guard-rescues-kayakers-off-oregon-coast
